resources.string:
Fit: the whole picture, with bars where the screen has another shape.
Fill (crop): fills the screen without distortion; edges that do not fit are cut off.
Stretch: fills the screen; shapes may look wider or taller.
1:1 pixels: one stream pixel per screen pixel. A smaller stream gets a border; a larger one is cropped.
Video position moves a Fit or 1:1 picture to the top. Pinch zoom works in every mode, and picture-in-picture always shows the whole picture.

Where a Fit or 1:1 picture sits when there is room left. Top keeps the space below free for the keyboard or the lower half of a folded phone. Fill and Stretch cover the whole screen, so this changes nothing there.
